pathwayProvenance: Candidate injection/readout body IDs extracted from spike revision ae754b0; anatomical claims and effectiveness require slice-03 probes. OLFACTORY_DN_* hold only source-annotated descending neurons on the named soma side; intrinsic cells such as 13500 (LHAV2p1) are lateral-horn candidates only.

visionInput.registration: MODELED, not calibrated retinal azimuth or measured receptive fields: u=(assignedOlHex1-min)/(max-min) over the full annotated family per somaSide; angle=+pi*u for R and -pi*u for L. raw[i,b]=max(0,cos(angle_i-b*pi/4)); raw<1e-12 becomes zero; divide each column by its sum, then the entire matrix by its largest row sum. Axis, orientation, mirroring and half-circle preferred-angle range are assumptions. Source hex1 ranges: L=[1.0, 36.0], R=[1.0, 36.0].
